passages.provision_quote: Performs an abortion knowing that the abortion is sought solely because of a genetic abnormality of the child.
passages.note: Chaptered text: the act restricts abortion by the reason sought and adds an interpretive personhood section, but sets no gestational limit and no rape/incest/life exception scheme.

rows.reasoning: His acts on SB1457 (2021) are real and in-term, but the bill's operative content bars abortions sought for a prohibited reason ("Performs an abortion knowing that the abortion is sought solely because of a genetic abnormality of the child.") and adds an interpretive rule that state law be "interpreted and construed to acknowledge, on behalf of an unborn child at every stage of development, all rights, privileges and immunities available to other persons"; the act itself states it "does not create or recognize a right to an abortion and does not make lawful an abortion that is currently unlawful." That is a different dimension from the one these rungs order, which is the stage of pregnancy at which abortion stays legal and which exceptions survive a ban — so nothing here chooses between "allow abortion during the first trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health", "ban abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life", and "ban abortion in all cases, with no exceptions."
